image_description: Two large blue plastic industrial drums (55-gallon style) positioned side-by-side on a wooden pallet outdoors. The left drum features a green hose connected to a spigot near the base and another hose entering from the side/top area. White labels are affixed to the upper sections of both drums. A chain-link fence and vegetation are visible in the background.
